profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Currently a graduate student in Computer Science seeking to broaden my knowledge into the fields of AI, machine learning and Data Science. Experienced software engineer with expertise on full-stack development, software life cycle applying agile methodologies, Continuous Integration and Delivery practices (CI/CD) and the inclusion of DevOps into organization culture. Eager to learn new tools and technologies that can make an impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Researched and developed a proof of concept on full text search by indexing company’s data into elastic-search to showcase potential features/customizations to be integrated into company’s platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated survey platform (solution for designing and capturing survey feedback for analysis) UI applications from Angular 1.5 to Angular 4 to achieve better performance and scalability. Project got demoed at C3 London (company’s biggest sales event).

Integrated NLP - text analytics - engine with survey platform - by connecting engine’s API with platform’s web services, enabling an intelligent conversational survey capable of detecting customer’s sentiment and give follow up questions accordingly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new survey platform using Docker and Aspnet Core for microservices, and Angular 1.5 for UI applications, keeping CI/CD pipeline in check. Project was demoed at C3 Miami.

Automated testing for backend and UI using Xunit, Jasmine, Protractor, achieving three times faster delivery cycles, high code coverage, and more reliable code.

Reviewed peers’ code using Github, resulting in more readable, structured and clean code.

Coordinated multi-cultural team’s effort in daily and planning meetings (USA, India, Perú) in order to meet deadlines for customer’s requirements resulting in deals of $160,000+.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed bank’s digital agent for financial transactions, targeting Android devices’ versions 14 to 19. Application was integrated with PIN devices to meet security standards.

Integrated Android and POS financial applications with banks’ servers by configuring communications private software and building C# libraries for customization.

Researched and integrated user’s fingerprint recognition services and hardware to feature new ways of authentication.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed mobile phone catalogue platform - a set of web applications built with Django to manage and showcase mobile inventory to customers - for big mobile carrier in Perú.

Deployed and monitored catalogue platform in Ubuntu virtual machines from DigitalOcean cloud services, resulting in closed deals with the firm.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Analyzed and designed new directory platform for a corporation's set of brands. Developed and deployed its web services using Aspnet framework and Azure cloud services.

Planned team’s efforts (iOS, Android and web developers) to meet business unit’s deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed features for Pathologists’ Slide Image Web Viewer using Aspnet framework.

Interviewed pathologists for requirements gathering and platform’s feedback.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed bank agencies’ location finder Android application.

Implemented modules for bank’s financial Android application.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Mentored students in application process for exchange internships to USA in areas of engineering.

Gave talks at universities about IAESTE in order to share the program's goals, benefits and application procedure.

Reached out companies and universities to find job opportunities for exchange incoming students.
Built games prototypes with Unity 3D to show tool’s capacity at workshops.

projects.title: Big Data / ML
projects.description:
•	Implemented image classifier with Convolutional Neural Networks.
•	Implemented a Recommender System using Spark with ALS and Graph Embedding.
•	Implemented a Twitter Sentiment Analytics using Spark Streaming.
•	Implemented a word ranking program (TF-IDF) for a corpus of documents using Hadoop, Spark and MPI.

projects.title: High Performance Computing
projects.description:
•	Implemented parallel code to be run across interconnected nodes within a cluster for HPC calculations (partial differential equations) using MPI, CUDA, OpenACC, OpenMP and Tensorflow to simulate surface water waves.
•	Integrated DMTCP checkpoint/restart into iterative code to assess trade-offs between fault tolerance and performance.
•	Implemented custom version of MPI using sockets for communication between nodes.
•	Implemented PMPI wrappers to analyze communication pattern between nodes.
•	Implemented MPI program to assess latency between nodes for different message sizes.
